about: Open-source KiCad boards that tools/corpus.py fetches at a pinned commit (blobless, sparse: only the board and project file; never committed) and runs the native kisi on – crashes, documented stops, run times and a few summary numbers per board are compared with validation/corpus/<set>.json. 'weekly': 32 boards run by the weekly CI (tier A SI-rich: high-speed interfaces, diff pairs, impedance classes; B PI-rich: many rails, large loads; C parser cases: KiCad 5–10, unusual stackups, panels, variants). 'robustness': about 200 boards stratified by KiCad generation, run by hand (Actions → ci → Run workflow, corpus: robustness) or before a release. 'licence' is the licence file found at the commit (NONE: none found – usable for local tests, not for release artefacts or numbers quoted in the docs); 'kicad' the board file's KiCad generation, 'layers' its copper layers. An entry may name a 'kisi_json' (validation/corpus/<name>.kisi.json, our own data: net names and values with sources) and a 'variant'. The candidate list comes from the kicad-happy test harness (github.com/aklofas/kicad-happy-testharness, its repos.md: repository URLs with pinned commits); only repository names and commits are taken from it, the selection and the facts here come from kisi's own analysis of the boards.

sources.text: Copper layers and file versions read from the board files at the pinned commits; licences from the licence files at those commits (2026-10-30).
Candidate repositories and pinned commits from repos.md of the kicad-happy test harness; selection by kisi's corpus analysis.
